title: Shift descent for a normalized isomorphism transport family
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbb Q_\ell$, and an isomorphism $g:X\to Y$ of schemes with $\ell$ invertible and stalk-unit proofs $h_X,h_Y$. Let $S_E$ be any family of IsomorphismFieldTransportStage packages for $g$, as in [def-pod-isomorphism-field-transport-clauses]. Let $c_E:j_E^Y\mathbin{\ggg}F_g\simeq F_{g,E}\mathbin{\ggg}j_E^X$ be any natural isomorphisms, with $F_g$ the prescribed commonStageDerivedPullback of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and $j_E$ the actual inclusions of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], such that every hom component of $c_E$ is heterogeneously equal to the identity on the literal pair $(E,F_{g,E}K)$. There is a coherent CommShift structure $q$ on $F_g$ such that every $c_E$ commutes with all integer shifts, using $q$, the published inclusionCommShift structures, and exactly $(S_E).rationalShift$. This assertion assumes no inverse family, equivalence, or triangle preservation.

proof.text: Invert each supplied lambda. Its prescribed component formula identifies its inverse with inverseImagePullbackComparisonDerived; inverse natural isomorphisms preserve the lambda shift equation. Apply the existing isomorphismPullbackScalarShift to these inverse lambdas and the supplied integral and rational shifts.

The stage transition shifts are the equality transports of the published rational scalar shifts. Consequently operationStageTransitionIso commutes with shifts. Whisker the finite scalar/shift equation with these identifications to obtain shift compatibility for the normalized coherent stage-system morphism.

Descend the finite shifts by including their components at each object’s own stage, conjugated by the inclusion shift comparisons. Compatibility with scalar comparisons proves naturality on every representative. The finite zero and addition laws descend componentwise, giving pairCommShift. Both restrictions to a stage have exactly that stage shift component, giving pairRestrictionShift. Representative uniqueness identifies the descended functor with commonStageDerivedPullback. Identity-normalized inclusion comparisons agree componentwise with the supplied c, so its shift equation is the restriction shift equation.

theorem isomorphismFieldTransportShiftDescent
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (S : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
      IsomorphismFieldTransportStage l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g hX hY)
    (c : ∀ E : Index l Ω,
      inclusion (Y := Y) E ⋙ commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g ≅
        rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g ⋙ inclusion (Y := X) E)
    (hc : ∀ (E : Index l Ω)
      (K : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) Y),
      HEq ((c E).hom.app K) (𝟙 (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω g
        ((inclusion (Y := Y) E).obj K)))) :
    ∃ q : (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g).CommShift ℤ,
      ∀ E : Index l Ω,
        @NatTrans.CommShift _ _ _ _ _ _ (c E).hom ℤ _ _ _
          (@Functor.CommShift.comp _ _ _ _ _ _
            (inclusion (Y := Y) E) (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω g) ℤ _ _ _ _
            (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusionCommShift
              (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := Y) E) q)
          (@Functor.CommShift.comp _ _ _ _ _ _
            (rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) g) (inclusion (Y := X) E)
            ℤ _ _ _ _ (S E).rationalShift
            (GeneralAlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.inclusionCommShift
              (l := l) (Ω := Ω) (Y := X) E))
